messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] inference-runtime: elevated 5xx rate detected (p95 latency spike). Pager triggered -> oncall marie. link: https://alerts.internal/INC-3184567890 :rotating_light:
marie: seeing it in dashboard, jumping in. rate is ~4.8% 5xx over last 5m, baseline 0.3%.
raj: I can confirm increased 5xx from model-runner group on us-east-1. Logs show repeated segfaults in runner-v2 around `kv_cache_commit()`
jamie: on which models? any particular model id?
raj: looks concentrated on model `redwood-13b-qlora-v2` and a few high-context requests to `redwood-chat-7b`.
marie: marking customer impact. taylor-cs can you estimate affected customers from request ids?
taylor-cs: quick check: two enterprise customers with high request volume in the window: AcmeCorp (webhooks) and FinSecure (batch embeddings). Both seeing higher error rates in their dashboards. AcmeCorp ~6% failed requests, FinSecure ~2.5%.
marie: priority: P1, page to runtime oncall + eng-sre. raj/jamie please coordinate mitigation. I'll start comms to customers.
chen-ops: if it's segfaults we should isolate nodes. Suggest removing node pool `runners-v2-us-east-1a` from LB and draining.
jamie: agree. I'm going to flip routing to fallback model variant `redwood-13b-qlora-v2-quant` for writes under 2k tokens to reduce memory pressure. Doing a soft-redirect in routing policy.
raj: logs show OOM patterns right before segfault: `std::bad_alloc` then SIGSEGV in approximate trace. Suspect a kernel-level allocation bug when KV cache grows beyond threshold.
marie: runbook step 3: enable kernel-fallback on affected hosts to use conservative allocator. raj can you push `runtime-config:set kernel_allocator=conservative --scope runners-v2-us-east-1a`
raj: executing now:
```
# applying conservative allocator to affected pool
cli runtime-config set --pool runners-v2-us-east-1a kernel_allocator conservative --reason "live mitigation"
```
raj: applied. Observability: tailing logs shows a drop in new segfaults but 5xx still ~3.2% (some retries).
sasha-sre: I recommend throttling large context requests for a bit to prevent cache blowups. We can set request_limits.max_context_tokens=2048 for that pool.
jamie: applying throttle via routing policy. patching in prod: `routing set-policy --pool runners-v2-us-east-1a --max-context 2048`
jamie: done. We should also warm up fallback pool to handle increased traffic. spinning up 4 extra `runners-v2-quant` instances.
chen-ops: starting scale-up: `autoscale --pool runners-v2-quant --count +4 --reason "mitigation"`
chen-ops: new instances coming up, health checks green.
marie: nice. visible drop to 1.1% 5xx now. still seeing isolated crashes on a couple hosts.
raj: isolating two nodes with unusually high OOMs: runner-37 and runner-39. marking them cordoned and collecting core dumps.
raj: command: `ssh runner-37 sudo systemctl stop model-runner && scp /var/crash/core.* s3://redwood-incident-dumps/3184567890/`
marie: collecting customer impact details for comms: AcmeCorp 6% failures -> mostly webhook POSTs, retries are spiking on their side. FinSecure smaller but some batch jobs failing. I'll prepare a brief with mitigation steps and ETA for full remediation (~60-90m).
taylor-cs: please include that we've rerouted to quant variant and throttled contexts; recommend clients retry with exponential backoff.
jamie: note: temporary quality delta with quant variant for some prompts. we'll include that in comms.
sasha-sre: suggest a post-incident action: add an early-kv-eviction threshold metric and an alert for `kv_cache_size > 85%` per runner. Currently we only alert on OOM/segfault.
marie: opened INC-3184567890 in tracker and assigned follow-ups: core analysis, kernel-allocator patch, alert tuning.
chen-ops: core dumps uploaded at s3://redwood-incident-dumps/3184567890/, link shared in incident ticket.
raj: preliminary stack trace shows allocation path from `kv_cache::commit` -> `gpu::alloc_async` -> `allocator::fast_alloc` before crash. forwarding to runtime-research.
jamie: temporary mitigation plan summary: 1) drain problematic nodes, 2) throttle large contexts, 3) route to quant fallback, 4) scale quant pool. All done.
marie: status update to #general in 15m. I'll post a short note and mention impacted customers + workaround.
marie: priority change: keeping P1 until core analysis complete and rate back to baseline for 30m.
incident-bot: [RESOLVE] alert cleared on us-east-1 model-runner group. last observed 5xx spike resolved.
marie: thanks team. moving to postmortem phase. action owners: raj (core debug), jamie (routing + alerting), sasha (alert thresholds), chen (ops scaling playbook), taylor (customer follow-ups).
marie: any other immediate concerns?
taylor-cs: I'll send customer notes now. logos: include link to status page + suggested retry/backoff instructions. :white_check_mark:
marie: closing thread once postmortem draft exists. good work everyone.
